paragraphs: Wilfrid Laurier International College (WLIC) is the official pathway college for Wilfrid Laurier University in Waterloo, Ontario. WLIC provides international students with structured university pathway programs, English for Academic Purposes, and a guaranteed progression route to Wilfrid Laurier University's undergraduate degree programs upon successful completion.

Situated on the Wilfrid Laurier University campus in Waterloo, Ontario, WLIC students benefit from immediate access to all university facilities — libraries, sports centres, student services — while receiving dedicated academic preparation support. Waterloo is at the heart of Canada's technology corridor, with the University of Waterloo and Wilfrid Laurier both anchoring a world-class innovation ecosystem.

Waterloo-Kitchener is home to Canada's third-largest technology hub, with major technology companies including Google, BlackBerry, and thousands of startups operating in the region. International students completing their pathway at WLIC gain admission to Laurier's highly regarded business (Lazaridis School) and arts programs.

Pathway completers proceed directly to Year 2 of Wilfrid Laurier University degree programs. Graduates from eligible Laurier programs qualify for the Post-Graduation Work Permit and Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program.
paragraphsRu: Wilfrid Laurier International College (WLIC) — официальный колледж-путеводитель Wilfrid Laurier University в Ватерлоо, Онтарио. Предоставляет иностранным студентам структурированные university pathway-программы и гарантированный путь к программам бакалавриата Wilfrid Laurier University.

Расположенный на кампусе Wilfrid Laurier University в Ватерлоо, студенты WLIC получают немедленный доступ ко всем университетским объектам, одновременно получая специализированную академическую подготовку.
Ватерлоо-Китченер — третий по величине технологический хаб Канады с Google, BlackBerry и тысячами стартапов. После завершения pathway студенты поступают на 2-й курс степенных программ Laurier.
Выпускники программ Wilfrid Laurier University имеют право на Post-Graduation Work Permit и Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program.
